docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Overview

Since ChatGPT was launched on November 30, 2022, AI has evolved at an incredible pace. More and more AI tools have become available, and today it almost feels unnecessary to maintain a tech website just to collect and organize technical information—the very reason I started this back in 2002.

Is that something to be thankful for, or is it bittersweet? I honestly don't know. Maybe it's a little of both.

Still, I come from a different era of technology, when finding useful information often meant hours of searching, experimenting, and taking notes. I guess that habit never really left me. I still enjoy collecting things that I think might be useful—whether for myself today or for someone else tomorrow. And that's why this tech site is still here.

docs.title: MkDocs
docs.text:
1. Using command mkdocs gh-deploy will deploy main to branch gh-pages, built-in command mkdocs build
  2. CNAME in the main root should be copied to site/, in order to make customized domain work.
  3. CNAME wjc.ox0.ca to apan-wjc.github.io should be set in DNS beforehand.

docs.title: SSH config for GitHub
docs.text:
1. Log in to Github.
  2. Go User/Settings
  3. Generate key pair with ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -a 100 -C "your-email@example.com" -f /opt/key/apan-wjc
  4. Add public key at Github.

  5. Add these to ~/.ssh/config

    Host github-apan-wjc
    HostName github.com
    User git
    IdentityFile /opt/key/apan-wjc
    IdentitiesOnly yes

  6. Add these to file .envrc in the root directory of the repo

    #!/bin/bash

git config user.email "your-email@example.com"
git config user.name "alex-wjc"

git remote set-url origin git@github-apan-wjc:apan-wjc/apan-wjc.github.io.git

  7. Run source .envrc whenever you enter this place, or use direnv do so automatically.

  8. Test it to verify the result
    ssh -T git@github-apan-wjc
Hi apan-wjc! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.

docs.title: Setup
docs.text:
cd /opt/apan-wjc.github.io
\rm -rf venv   # if venv already exists and need to redo

source venv/bin/activate
pip --version
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install mkdocs
pip install mkdocs-material
mkdocs --version
mkdocs new .   # ONLY for the first time
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000

docs.title: Publish
docs.text:
After all change looks good, the following command will launch a deployment and update the site 

cd /opt/apan-wjc.github.io

git status
git diff

mkdocs build   # will build/renew local site

git add -A && git commit -a -m "XXXXXXXXX"
git push

mkdocs gh-deploy   # includes `mkdocs build` command, so no need to run it, BUT the deployment is at Github
or
mkdocs gh-deploy --force

docs.title: MkDocs features
docs.text:
features:
    - navigation.tabs
    - navigation.tabs.sticky   # keeps tabs visible when scrolling
    - navigation.indexes       # lets a folder's index.md serve as its landing page
    # - navigation.sections      # groups sidebar items into labeled sections
    - navigation.top           # adds a "back to top" button
navigation.sections

Without navigation.sections → nested groups are collapsible/expandable, arrow-based (what we want)

With navigation.sections → nested groups become permanently-expanded static headers, useful for docs where we always want everything visible at once (not what we want here)

docs.title: collapsible admonition
docs.text:
( foldable tex box )

Add these to mkdocs.yml, root level: 

markdown_extensions:
  - admonition
  - pymdownx.details
  - pymdownx.superfences

admonition — base support for callout boxes (note, warning, tip, etc.)

pymdownx.details — makes those callout boxes collapsible (adds the > arrow and click-to-expand)

pymdownx.superfences — needed if you ever nest code blocks inside admonitions (good to have alongside)

This is normal text, but *this part is smaller*{: .small-text} in size.

docs.title: 9x9 multiple table
docs.text: seq 1 9 | awk '{for(j=1;j<=$1;j++) printf "%d×%d=%-2d ", j, $1, j*$1; print ""}'

docs.title: Pascal's triangle
docs.text:
N=9
seq 0 "$N" | awk -v N="$N" '
{
    for (i = 0; i < N - $1; i++)
        printf "  "

    c = 1
    for (k = 0; k <= $1; k++) {
        printf "%-5d", c
        c = c * ($1 - k) / (k + 1)
    }
    print ""
}'

docs.title: Publish repo to site
docs.text:
Make a workflow file .github/workflow/issueMySite.yml with the following content with Chinese explanation 

# 工作流的名称
name: publish site
# 在什么时候触发工作流
on: 
  # 在从本地main分支被push到GitHub仓库时
  push: 
    branches:
      - main
  # 在main分支合并别人提的pr时
  pull_request: 
    branches:
      - main
# 工作流的具体内容
jobs: 
  deploy:
    # 创建一个新的云端虚拟机 使用最新Ubuntu系统
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest 
    steps:
        # 先checkout到main分支
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2 
        # 再安装Python3和相关环境
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v2 
        with:
          python-version: 3.x
        # 使用pip包管理工具安装mkdocs-material
      - run: pip install mkdocs-material 
      - # 使用mkdocs-material部署gh-pages分支
      - run: mkdocs gh-deploy --force
